title: •Han’s Heavy Blaster Pistol
caption: •Han’s Heavy Blaster Pistol (V)
game_text: Deploy on Han (except TK-422), even as a ‘react.’ May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target hit, its forfeit = 0, and opponent loses 1 Force if destiny +1 > defense value. Once during your control phase, may fire using 1 Force.
lore: BlasTech DL-44 heavy blaster pistol. Short range, but relatively powerful. Carries energy for 25 shots. Illegal or restricted in most systems.
